caption.purpose: Inter 400, 12/16, muted. Sub-lines, hints, empty values.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per screen (e.g. Add patient).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-primary, #2E7040); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #fff); font: 500 16px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #2E7040) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ring, #2E7040) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-input, #D6D3D1); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-background, #fff); color: var(--color-foreground, #1C1917); font: 500 16px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-secondary, #F0F7F1); color: var(--color-secondary-foreground, #1A3B24); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ring, #2E7040) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Top Nav Item
components.description: Primary nav link in the 64px top header; active is a green tint, not a fill.
components.html: PatientsConsultations
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; height: 64px; align-items: center; padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border, #E7E5E4); background: var(--color-background, #fff); } .ds-nav-item { padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 16px/24px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-neutral-70, #292524); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--color-muted, #F5F5F4); color: var(--color-foreground, #1C1917); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current=page] { background: var(--color-primary-00, #F0F7F1); color: var(--color-primary-07, #255A34); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-ring, #2E7040); }

components.name: Safety Pill
components.description: One pill per allergy; wraps, never truncates. Empty list reads "None recorded" in muted text.
components.css: .ds-pills { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-pill-safety { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-destructive-01, #FEF2F2); color: var(--color-destructive-70, #991B1B); font: 500 12px/16px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Register Primary Cell
components.description: Name plus a muted tabular sub-line of identifiers (Reg. No. · phone).
components.css: .ds-cell { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-cell p { margin: 0; } .ds-cell-name { font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-foreground, #1C1917); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-cell-sub { font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #78716C); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

rules.name: Status pill
rules.body: Status pill = bg-<status>-01 text-<status>-70 (light tint + dark text). Never solid status fills in tables.

rules.name: Safety pill
rules.body: Safety pill (allergies) = bg-destructive-01 text-destructive-70 rounded-full text-xs font-medium, one pill per fact, wrapping, never truncated. An empty list reads quietly (text-xs text-muted-foreground, "None recorded").

rules.name: Borders over shadows
rules.body: Cards are border border-border bg-card. Shadows only for floating layers (menus, popovers, drawers).

dos: Do reuse a `_reference/` pattern (e.g. a list page with drawer) by re-creating it with Ayurveda AI data.
Do keep copy short, sentence case ("Add patient", not "ADD NEW PATIENT").
donts: Don't invent one-off components, colors, spacings, or shadows.
Don't put business logic in pages; hooks in `features/<x>/hooks`, helpers in `src/utils`.
